item.title: Quantifying Correlations Between Small Particles to Unlock Quantum Technologies
item.description: A team led by RWTH professor Mario Berta has presented a groundbreaking method for measuring quantum entanglement with greater precision than ever before. The study, published in Nature Physics, could play a decisive role in unlocking the full potential of quantum technologies for communication and data processing.

item.title: New DFG Research Group: Decoding the Multilingual Mind
item.description: Few regions in Europe are as multilingual as the Euregio Meuse-Rhine, a cross-border area spanning parts of Germany, Belgium, and the Netherlands. Here, people’s lives are shaped by a blend of native languages, frequent cross-border communication, and diverse cultural experiences.
